Log In interdiction noun in·​ter·​dic·​tion ˌin-tər-ˈdik-shən How to pronounce interdiction (audio) 1 in the civil law of Louisiana : removal of the right to care for one's own person and affairs called also complete interdiction, full interdiction compare limited interdiction 2 : the act or an instance of interdicting interdiction of drugs Browse Nearby Words interdict interdiction interest See all Nearby Words Cite this Entry Style MLA Chicago APA Merriam-Webster “Interdiction.” Merriam-Webster.com Legal Dictionary, Merriam-Webster, https://www.merriam-webster.com/legal/interdiction.
